contexts.text: Every precious thing, etc. () = the Knowledges of faith.
Things of slight importance to man are precious to the Angels. AC 2551:2. AC 2574:end.
He gave precious things to her brother () = spiritual things for natural good... That precious things = spiritual things. Illustrated.
Precious things of Heaven () = spiritual things, which are the dew.
A precious stone = higher or interior truth.
A precious stone = truth translucent from the Lord's Divine. Illustrated.
As the truths and goods of faith are signified by precious stones, intelligence and wisdom are signified by them.
A precious stone () = the truth of faith from the good of love. References.
That the precious stones which were in the breastplate = Divine truths from Divine good. Illustrated.
For precious stones represent according to their colours, Explained.
They accumulate precious things the same as in the world; for there are far more precious things in the Spiritual World...
These precious things () = the Knowledges of good and truth, from which is doctrine.
To be made rich by her costliness () = to be made acceptable to God by the holy things of that religiosity. Explained. AE 1176.
That the holy things of the Church are signified by precious things. Illustrated.
Their exaltation to uses, and the derivative preciousnesses.
Who loves a stone except from its preciousness?
Kings' daughters are among the precious ones () = the affections of truth themselves.
The precious things of the earth () = spiritual goods and the derivative truths which are of the Church.

The precious things of heaven, the dew, and the abyss lying beneath () = spiritual celestial things in the internal and external man. The precious things of the produce of the sun, and the precious things of the product of the months () = all things which proceed from the Celestial Kingdom and the Spiritual Kingdom...
The precious things of heaven = Divine spiritual things. AE 448:7.
When the goods of charity are genuine, they are called precious things of the hills of an age (). ( = genuine truths such as were in the Ancient Church. AE 448:7.)
Kings' daughters = spiritual affections of truth, which are called precious when the truths are genuine.
Precious, in the Word, is said of truths.
Precious wood () = excellent good; thus rational good.
